info.title: RTVI
info.description: The Real-Time Voice Interface protocol between a client and a Pipecat server, from the server's point of view. Every message is a JSON object labeled "rtvi-ai" that the transport carries as a data message.

rtvi.description: The session's data channel, in both directions.

receiveClientMessages.summary: Messages the client sends to the server.

sendServerMessages.summary: Messages the server sends to the client.

A11yNode.description:
One node in the UI accessibility snapshot tree.

Mirrors the client-side ``A11yNode`` wire shape. Extra fields are
allowed so clients can add platform-specific or future metadata
without breaking older servers.

Parameters:
    ref: Stable client-assigned element reference.
    role: ARIA-style role for the node.
    name: Optional accessible name.
    value: Optional current value for inputs/progress/etc.
    state: Optional short state tags (e.g. ``"focused"``,
        ``"disabled"``, ``"offscreen"``).
    level: Optional heading level.
    colcount: Optional column count for grid-like containers.
    rowcount: Optional row count for grid-like containers.
    children: Optional child nodes.
A11yNode.title: A11yNode

A11ySelection.description:
The user's current text selection in the UI snapshot.

Extra fields are allowed for forward compatibility with client
snapshot additions.

Parameters:
    ref: Ref of the element that carries the selection.
    text: Selected text.
    start_offset: Optional selection start offset.
    end_offset: Optional selection end offset.
A11ySelection.title: A11ySelection

A11ySnapshot.description:
Client accessibility snapshot sent in a ``ui-snapshot`` message.

Mirrors the client-side ``A11ySnapshot`` wire shape. Extra fields
are allowed so clients can add compatible metadata over time.

Parameters:
    root: Root accessibility node.
    captured_at: Client-side epoch milliseconds when captured.
    selection: Optional current text selection.
A11ySnapshot.title: A11ySnapshot

AboutClientData.description:
Data about the RTVI client.

Contains information about the client, including which RTVI library it
is using, what platform it is on and any additional details, if available.
AboutClientData.title: AboutClientData

AudioLevelMessageData.description: Data format for sending audio levels.
AudioLevelMessageData.title: AudioLevelMessageData

BotCapabilities.description:
What a bot does in a session.

Every field is optional: ``None`` means unknown, and a client should keep
its default behavior for it. ``False`` means the bot does not do it, so a
client can hide the matching UI.

Parameters:
    audio_in: Whether the bot receives the user's audio.
    audio_out: Whether the bot sends audio to the user.
    video_in: Whether the bot receives the user's video.
    screen_in: Whether the bot receives the user's screen share. Known when
        the transport captures its video sources from ``video_in_sources``;
        unknown when the application captures them itself.
    video_out: Whether the bot sends video to the user.
    metrics: Whether the bot reports metrics.
BotCapabilities.title: BotCapabilities

BotLLMMarkerMessageData.description:
Data for a bot LLM marker message.

Parameters:
    text: The marker as the LLM produced it; empty when the response
        carried none.
    kind: What the marker means, in the emitter's vocabulary (the
        turn-completion mixin's ``complete``, ``short`` or ``long``), or
        ``None`` when the emitter gave none.
    raw: The response's text as the LLM produced it, markers included.
    markers: Every marker the emitter recognizes.
BotLLMMarkerMessageData.title: BotLLMMarkerMessageData

BotOutputMessageData.description:
Data for bot output RTVI messages.

Extends TextMessageData to include metadata about the output.

This class supports both protocol v1 (1.4.x) and v2 (2.0.0+) clients. The
observer populates different field subsets depending on the negotiated version;
``send_rtvi_message`` serialises with ``exclude_none=True`` so each client
only sees the fields relevant to its version.

Parameters:
    output_type: What form the text is in (e.g., sentence, code, etc.).
    text_type: What form the text is in, always the same as ``output_type``.

        .. deprecated:: 1.14.0
            Use ``output_type`` instead.
            Will be removed in 2.0.0.

    aggregated_by: What form the text is in, always the same as ``output_type``.

        .. deprecated:: 1.13.0
            Use ``output_type`` instead.
            Will be removed in 2.0.0.

    segment_id: ID of the source AggregatedTextFrame.
    spoken: **(v1 only)** Whether the text has been spoken by TTS.
    will_be_spoken: **(v2+)** Whether the text will be spoken by TTS.
    spoken_status: **(v2+)** Lifecycle status of the segment: ``"new"`` on
        its first message, the only one for text that isn't spoken;
        ``"in-progress"`` as each of its words is spoken, for TTS services
        with word timestamps; ``"completed"`` once its last word is spoken.
    spoken_progress: **(v2+)** Accumulated / remaining text breakdown.
        Present when ``will_be_spoken`` is ``True``.
    delivery: **(2.3.0+)** The delivery of the text just spoken, by its
        universal names, such as ``["warm", "emphasis"]``, empty for the
        voice's baseline. They change within a segment where its delivery
        does, so a segment's ``"new"`` message has none. Present in
        expressive conversation (alpha).
BotOutputMessageData.title: BotOutputMessageData

BotReadyData.description:
Data for bot ready notification.

Contains protocol version and initial configuration.

Parameters:
    version: The RTVI protocol version the bot speaks with this client.
    about: Information about the bot, such as the Pipecat library and version.
    capabilities: What the bot does in this session (media sent and received,
        metrics), so the client can show only the UI that applies. Added in
        protocol 2.2.0.
BotReadyData.title: BotReadyData

ClientReadyData.description:
Data format of client ready messages.

Contains the RTVI protocol version and client information.
ClientReadyData.title: ClientReadyData

DTMFInputData.description:
Data format for DTMF keypresses sent from the client.

Carries one or more keypad entries (``0``-``9``, ``*``, ``#``), delivered
in order, so the bot's DTMF handling (e.g. a ``DTMFAggregator``) sees them
exactly as a telephony transport would deliver rapid keypresses.

Protocol 2.1.0 replaced the single ``button`` field with ``buttons``.
DTMFInputData.title: DTMFInputData

ErrorData.description:
Data for an RTVI error event.

Contains error information including whether it's fatal.
ErrorData.title: ErrorData

ErrorResponseData.description:
Data for an RTVI error response.

Contains the error message to send back to the client.
ErrorResponseData.title: ErrorResponseData

File.description: File data structure for RTVI file sending.
File.title: File

FileUrl.description:
File source as a URL.

Parameters:
    url: The file's URL: whatever the ``POST /files`` upload endpoint
        returned (``pipecat:<id>`` with the default local storage, or a
        URL minted by a custom storage backend), a cloud-storage URI
        (``s3://``, ``gs://``), or a plain ``http(s)`` URL. The URL is
        resolved at completion time: the LLM provider fetches it itself
        when it can (public URLs, its own cloud IAM), and otherwise the
        LLM service's :class:`~pipecat.utils.file_resolver.FileResolver`
        downloads the bytes and inlines them.
FileUrl.title: FileUrl

KeypadEntry.description:
DTMF keypad entries for phone system integration.

Parameters:
    ONE: Number key 1.
    TWO: Number key 2.
    THREE: Number key 3.
    FOUR: Number key 4.
    FIVE: Number key 5.
    SIX: Number key 6.
    SEVEN: Number key 7.
    EIGHT: Number key 8.
    NINE: Number key 9.
    ZERO: Number key 0.
    POUND: Pound/hash key (#).
    STAR: Star/asterisk key (*).
KeypadEntry.title: KeypadEntry

LLMFunctionCallInProgressMessageData.description:
Data for LLM function call in-progress notification.

Contains function call details including name, ID, and arguments.
Fields may be omitted based on the configured function_call_report_level for security.

Parameters:
    tool_call_id: Unique identifier of the call.
    function_name: Name of the function called.
    arguments: Arguments passed to the function.
LLMFunctionCallInProgressMessageData.title: LLMFunctionCallInProgressMessageData

LLMFunctionCallMessageData.description:
Data for LLM function call notification.

Contains function call details including name, ID, and arguments.

.. deprecated:: 0.0.102
    Use :class:`LLMFunctionCallInProgressMessageData` instead. Will be removed in 2.0.0.
LLMFunctionCallMessageData.title: LLMFunctionCallMessageData

LLMFunctionCallResultData.description:
Data for LLM function call result.

Contains function call details and result.
LLMFunctionCallResultData.title: LLMFunctionCallResultData

LLMFunctionCallStartMessageData.description:
Data for LLM function call start notification.

Contains the function name being called. Fields may be omitted based on
the configured function_call_report_level for security.

Parameters:
    function_name: Name of the function called.
LLMFunctionCallStartMessageData.title: LLMFunctionCallStartMessageData

LLMFunctionCallStoppedMessageData.description:
Data for LLM function call stopped notification.

Contains details about the function call that stopped, including
whether it was cancelled or completed with a result.
Fields may be omitted based on the configured function_call_report_level for security.

Parameters:
    tool_call_id: Unique identifier of the call.
    cancelled: Whether the call was cancelled rather than completed.
    function_name: Name of the function called.
    result: The result, when the call completed with one.
LLMFunctionCallStoppedMessageData.title: LLMFunctionCallStoppedMessageData

RawAudioBatchData.description:
Data format for a ``raw-audio-batch`` message: several chunks of the user's audio.

Parameters:
    base64AudioBatch: Chunks of 16-bit PCM audio, each base64-encoded, in order.
    sampleRate: The audio's sample rate, in Hz.
    numChannels: The audio's number of channels.
RawAudioBatchData.title: RawAudioBatchData

RawAudioData.description:
Data format for a ``raw-audio`` message: one chunk of the user's audio.

Parameters:
    base64Audio: 16-bit PCM audio, base64-encoded.
    sampleRate: The audio's sample rate, in Hz.
    numChannels: The audio's number of channels.
RawAudioData.title: RawAudioData

RawClientMessageData.description: Data structure expected from client messages sent to the RTVI server.
RawClientMessageData.title: RawClientMessageData

RawServerResponseData.description: Data structure for server responses to client messages.
RawServerResponseData.title: RawServerResponseData

STTRawTextMessageData.description:
Data for STT raw text messages.

Parameters:
    text: The transcribed text.
    user_id: Identifier for the user who spoke.
    timestamp: When the user said it.
    final: Whether the transcription is final, as opposed to interim.
    speaker: Who said it, when the STT service's diarization tells speakers
        apart.
STTRawTextMessageData.title: STTRawTextMessageData

SendFileData.description:
Data format for sending a file to the LLM.

Contains the information of the file to send and any options for how the pipeline should process it.
SendFileData.title: SendFileData

SendFileOptions.description: Options for sending a file to the LLM.
SendFileOptions.title: SendFileOptions

SendTextData.description:
Data format for sending text input to the LLM.

Contains the text content to send and any options for how the pipeline should process it.
SendTextData.title: SendTextData

SendTextOptions.description:
Options for sending text input to the LLM.

Contains options for how the pipeline should process the text input.
SendTextOptions.title: SendTextOptions

SpokenProgressData.description:
Word-level TTS progress within a spoken segment.

Parameters:
    accumulated_text: Text already spoken in this segment, including the current word.
    remaining_text: Text not yet spoken in this segment.
SpokenProgressData.title: SpokenProgressData

TextMessageData.description:
Data for text-based RTVI messages.

Contains text content.
TextMessageData.title: TextMessageData

TextType.description:
Built-in text types.

``BACKCHANNEL`` is a short acknowledgment the bot says while the user talks,
such as "Mm-hmm.". Text can also have a type of its own, such as ``"code"``.

``EXPRESSION_SOUND`` and ``EXPRESSION_PAUSE`` are part of expressive
conversation (alpha): a sound or a silence an LLM writes into its reply,
which isn't spoken as words. The text is the sound's name, as written in
its tag, or the pause's duration in milliseconds.
TextType.title: TextType

TranscriptionSpeaker.description:
A speaker an STT service's diarization told apart in a transcription stream.

Labels are opaque and provider-specific. Numbers count speakers in the order
they first appeared in the STT service's session, so they read the same
whatever labels the provider uses. Both only hold within that session: a
provider that restarts its labels (e.g. after a reconnect) may give a known
label, and so its number, to a different person, and services that diarize
each speech segment separately don't keep labels across segments.

Parameters:
    label: The provider's label for the speaker (e.g. ``"A"``, ``"S1"``,
        ``"2"``).
    number: The speaker's place in the order speakers first appeared,
        starting at ``1``.
TranscriptionSpeaker.title: TranscriptionSpeaker

UICancelJobGroupData.description:
Inner ``data`` for a ``ui-cancel-job-group`` message.

Parameters:
    job_id: The job group id the client wants cancelled.
    reason: Optional human-readable reason.
UICancelJobGroupData.title: UICancelJobGroupData

UICommandData.description:
Inner ``data`` for a ``ui-command`` message.

Parameters:
    command: App-defined command.
    payload: App-defined payload (already a plain dict by the
        time it lands on the wire). The standard command payload models
        below produce the right shape via ``model_dump()``.
UICommandData.title: UICommandData

UIEventData.description:
Inner ``data`` for a ``ui-event`` message.

Parameters:
    event: App-defined event.
    payload: App-defined payload, schemaless by design.
UIEventData.title: UIEventData

UIJobCompletedData.description:
``data`` for a ``ui-job-group`` envelope with kind ``job_completed``.

Parameters:
    kind: Always ``"job_completed"``.
    job_id: The shared job-group identifier.
    worker_name: The worker that produced the response.
    status: Completion status string.
    response: The worker's response payload.
    at: Epoch milliseconds when the response was received.
UIJobCompletedData.title: UIJobCompletedData

UIJobGroupCompletedData.description:
``data`` for a ``ui-job-group`` envelope with kind ``group_completed``.

Parameters:
    kind: Always ``"group_completed"``.
    job_id: The shared job-group identifier.
    at: Epoch milliseconds when the group completed.
UIJobGroupCompletedData.title: UIJobGroupCompletedData

UIJobGroupStartedData.description:
``data`` for a ``ui-job-group`` envelope with kind ``group_started``.

Parameters:
    kind: Always ``"group_started"``.
    job_id: Shared job-group identifier for the group.
    workers: Names of the workers the work was dispatched to.
    label: Optional human-readable label for the group.
    cancellable: Whether the client may request cancellation.
    at: Epoch milliseconds when the group started.
UIJobGroupStartedData.title: UIJobGroupStartedData

UIJobUpdateData.description:
``data`` for a ``ui-job-group`` envelope with kind ``job_update``.

Parameters:
    kind: Always ``"job_update"``.
    job_id: The shared job-group identifier.
    worker_name: The worker that produced the update.
    data: The worker's update payload, forwarded verbatim.
    at: Epoch milliseconds when the update was emitted.
UIJobUpdateData.title: UIJobUpdateData

UISnapshotData.description:
Inner ``data`` for a ``ui-snapshot`` message.

The accessibility snapshot tree mirrors the client-side
``A11ySnapshot`` wire shape and is kept forward-compatible by
allowing extra fields on the snapshot models.

Parameters:
    tree: The serialized accessibility tree.
UISnapshotData.title: UISnapshotData

UserInputMessageData.description:
Data for user input messages.

Parameters:
    text: What the user said or typed.
    input_type: What kind of input it is: ``"transcription"`` for speech
        transcribed by the STT, ``"chat"`` for text the client sent, or
        ``"backchannel"`` for a short acknowledgment the user said while the
        bot talks, such as "mhm".
    timestamp: When the user said or sent it.
    final: Whether the text is final. Only an interim transcription isn't.
    user_id: Identifier for the user who spoke or typed. For chat, set only
        when the transport knows the sender, such as Daily and LiveKit.
    msg_id: For chat, the id of the client's ``send-text`` message.
    perception: For a transcription, how the user said it, when the STT
        service reports a reading with it. Part of expressive conversation
        (alpha).
    speaker: For a transcription, who said it, when the STT service's
        diarization tells speakers apart.
UserInputMessageData.title: UserInputMessageData

UserPerceptionLabel.description:
A label of a perception signal, with how sure the reading is.

Parameters:
    label: The label, such as ``"frustrated"``.
    confidence: How sure the reading is, from 0 to 1.
UserPerceptionLabel.title: UserPerceptionLabel

UserPerceptionSignal.description:
One signal of a reading of how the user spoke.

Parameters:
    name: What is read, such as ``"tone"``.
    labels: The likeliest labels, likeliest first, for a signal read as labels.
    value: The measure, for a signal read as a value.
UserPerceptionSignal.title: UserPerceptionSignal

UserTranscriptionMessageData.description:
Data for user transcription messages.

Contains transcription text and metadata.

.. deprecated:: 1.13.0
    Use :class:`STTRawTextMessageData` instead. Will be removed in 2.0.0.
UserTranscriptionMessageData.title: UserTranscriptionMessageData
